name: paper-index
description: Indexes a PDF literature library down to the full text and searches it. Scopus searches fetch abstracts too (COMPLETE view) and are matched against the papers you hold; open-access papers you lack are downloaded to a staging folder and turned into full text (--fetch-oa). Files are matched again by content when their names change. The API key is read only from an environment variable.
